stories.title: Rybakina Wins 2026 US Open Women's Title — Defeats Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Rybakina beats Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to win the 2026 US Open. Her 3rd Grand Slam title, first US Open crown. She takes the world No. 1 ranking on Monday. #USOpen #Tennis #Rybakina #WTA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Sabalenka's US Open three-peat bid is over. Rybakina wins in 2h21m. Three different women claimed Grand Slams in 2026 — Rybakina, Andreeva, Rybakina again. Sabalenka reached both finals. #USOpen #WTA #Tennis #Sabalenka

facebook.image_caption: Elena Rybakina: 2026 US Open champion. 🏆 Three Grand Slam titles, world No. 1 starting Monday. Rybakina def. Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2.

stories.title: Shelton Chases History — First American Men's GS Since Roddick 2003

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: Ben Shelton today: first Black American in a US Open final since Arthur Ashe in 1972. A win ends the 23-year drought for American men at Grand Slams. 2 PM ET on ESPN. #USOpen #Shelton #Tennis #USOpen2026

stories.title: Rybakina's New No. 1 Era Begins Monday

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: It's official Monday: Sabalenka's 99-week run as world No. 1 is over. Rybakina takes the top spot for the first time. First Kazakh player (ATP or WTA) to hold No. 1. #WTA #Rybakina #Tennis #USOpen

facebook.image_caption: Elena Rybakina: the new WTA world No. 1 starting Monday. First Kazakh player (ATP or WTA) ever to hold the top ranking. 🎾 #Tennis
